items.title: How Much Passive Income $800,000 in Edison, International Paper, Altria and AT&T Pays Each Year
items.summary: One of these four high-yield dividend payers earns less than it hands out, while another faces a wildfire liability nobody can price. Before you build a retirement paycheck around them, find out which stocks carry the real risk.

items.title: Consolidated Edison Q3 Earnings Lag Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: ED's Q3 revenues rise 8.5% and earnings grow 8.4%, while the utility narrows its 2026 earnings guidance and outlines $38 billion in planned investments.

items.title: Ameren Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: AEE's Q3 earnings beat estimates by 5.7%, prompting higher 2026 guidance as infrastructure investments and stronger electricity sales drive growth.

items.title: Evergy's Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates, '26 EPS View Raised
items.summary: EVRG beats Q3 2026 earnings and revenue estimates, fueled by growth in its Kansas Central and Metro businesses, and raises its full-year EPS outlook.

items.title: Duke Energy Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates on 2% Retail Load Growth
items.summary: DUK's Q3 earnings and revenues beat estimates, driven by infrastructure investment recovery, rising electricity demand and favorable weather.

items.title: The Dividend ETF That Takes the Dogs of the Dow Strategy Across Every Sector
items.summary: An obscure $1.4 billion ETF has quietly beaten one of Wall Street's most popular dividend funds this year by applying a decades-old stock-screening trick to every corner of the market. The question is whether the strategy holds an edge or just got lucky.

items.title: Entergy Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Increase Year Over Year
items.summary: ETR beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as strong electricity demand, favorable weather and regulatory rate actions drive growth, while higher costs pressure results.
